dates.description: Show the last modified date of files and directories

show_git_info.description: Show git statuses on files and stats on repo

git_status.description: Only show files having an interesting git status, including hidden ones

sizes.description: Show the size of files and directories

sort_by_count.description: Sort by count (only show one level of the tree)

sort_by_date.description: Sort by date (only show one level of the tree)

sort_by_size.description: Sort by size (only show one level of the tree)

sort_by_type_dirs_first.description: Sort by type, directories first (only show one level of the tree)

sort_by_type_dirs_last.description: Sort by type, directories last (only show one level of the tree)

trim_root.description: Trim the root too and dont show a scrollbar

whale_spotting.description: Sort by size, show ignored and hidden files

color.description: Whether to have styles and colors (default is usually OK) [possible values: auto, yes, no]

outcmd.description: Where to write the produced cmd (if any)

conf.description: Semicolon separated paths to specific config files

height.description: Height (if you dont want to fill the screen or for file export)

install.description: Install or reinstall the br shell function

print_shell_function.description: Print to stdout the br function for a given shell

listen.description: A socket to listen to for commands

get_root.description: Ask for the current root of the remote broot

write_default_conf.description: Write default conf files in given directory

send.description: A socket that broot sends commands to before quitting
